description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering holiday search parameters within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends a date range filter, adds an 'exclude recurring' option, and specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: HolidaySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filtering criteria when searching holidays, including date range and whether to exclude recurring holidays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter with default sort field set to 'holiday.date'.

methods.name: isExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Returns whether recurring holidays are excluded from search results.

methods.name: setExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Sets whether to exclude recurring holidays from search results.
